about_the_game:
Get ready for a squishy, chaotic showdown! In SquishySmash, you'll become adorable, wobbly characters and dive into hilarious physics-based brawls on surprising and laugh-filled stages.

​🎭 Unique Characters, Each a League of Their Own!​

​
Choose your favorite fighting style: become an unstoppable hammer-wielding titan deciding matches with earth-shattering blows, or an elusive balloon-handler keeping opponents guessing. Each character boasts unique skills and distinctly different control feels, ensuring every match is a fresh experience.

​🎡 Dynamic Stages, Full of Surprises!​

​
The battlefield itself is a crazy amusement park! ⚙️ Watch out for mischievous contraptions—spinning pendulums sweep across the arena, fragile glass floors collapse without warning, and bouncy launchpads send you flying! 🎉 Even more thrilling are the randomly triggered crazy events: zero-gravity mode makes everyone float, super bounce time doubles the knockback effect, and even a giant mechanical cat boss might suddenly intrude, instantly turning the tables!

​⚡️ Easy to Pick Up


Each fast-paced round lasts just 2-5 minutes, and the unlimited respawn mechanism means you never wait long. Simple, intuitive controls let newcomers jump right into the fun, while the diverse character roster and strategic depth keep core players engaged for hours. Play consistently to unlock a variety of cool skins, hilarious emotes, and honor medals to create your unique look.

​

👥 More Players, More Fun!​


It's best enjoyed with your friends, whether online, competing to determine the true "King of the Squish" amidst laughter and shouts. Remember—here, winning or losing isn't what counts; the one who laughs the loudest is the real champion!

name: SquishySmash

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (32or64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD A6
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 740 / AMD Radeon HD 5770 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (32or64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: A physics-based multiplayer party brawler! Ditch complex combos—choose wobbly heroes, wield absurd weapons, and fling foes off chaotic stages. With vibrant visuals and unpredictable physics, no two battles are the same. Pure laughter for you and friends!
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Swedish, Korean
